_purpose: Per-company override of the default confirm-before-submit behavior. Read by autofill-agent (see .claude/skills/autofill-agent/SKILL.md, Workflow step 6) before the final Submit click on any application. company_id values match automation/job-search/_internal/sources.json.
_values: 'confirm' = show full filled application and wait for explicit yes (default, safe). 'auto' = submit immediately after filling, no confirmation — only for companies the user has explicitly turned this on for.
